explanation: Solving for z gives z=1±√(2-x²-(y+3)²). Real values require x²+(y+3)²≤2, the interior and boundary of the circle of radius √2 centered at (0,-3).

answers.correct_value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $\sqrt{2}$ centered at $(0,-3)$
answers.wrong_value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $2$ centered at $(0,-3)$
